art_note: The editorial campaign imagery successfully elevates the intimates into a luxury lifestyle narrative, contrasting with the basic flat ghost mannequin shots.
desc_en: An intimate piece designed to offer maximum comfort without compromising playful and authentic style. Crafted from a medium-weight fabric with four-way stretch, this garment adapts flexibly to the silhouette. It features a soft black plush elastic waistband that provides support throughout the day. The design is completed by an all-over print on a warm beige background and the house monogram at the front. Made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una pieza íntima pensada para brindar máxima comodidad sin perder el estilo divertido y auténtico. Elaborada en un tejido de peso medio con elasticidad en cuatro direcciones, esta prenda se adapta con total flexibilidad a la silueta. Cuenta con una suave cinturilla elástica de felpa en tono negro que ofrece soporte durante toda la jornada. El diseño se completa con un estampado integral sobre fondo beige y el monograma de la casa en el frontal. Fabricado bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: 97% polyester, 3% spandex
· Fabric weight: 180 g/m² (5.3 oz/yd²)
· Technical properties: 4-way stretch, breathable and antimicrobial fabric
· Fit: regular fit with soft plush elastic waistband
· Details: all-over print and front monogram
· Made to order in the USA
